historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 1771 - 17th Avenue, the vote to overrule failing 3-2 for want of the required four votes, following a site inspection.
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the imposition of a penalty in connection with the permit to alter the building at 1771 17th Avenue.
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 1771 17th Avenue, on condition that the lotline window be eliminated.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works and granted the permit to alter the building at 1771 - 17th Avenue, on the condition that the rail around the deck be constructed as an open grilled guard rail to meet the minimum requirement of the code.
